title: Buddha's teaching of four more inhabited Earth-like planets

tellings.quote: As the great Buddha wrote 2,600 years ago, in our solar system, there are four more planets similar to planet Earth where practically the same exact people live

plain: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov, a former president of a republic within Russia who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, spoke about this on a podcast. He says the Buddha wrote, 2,600 years ago, that our solar system holds four more planets like Earth where almost exactly the same kind of people live. If true, it would mean an ancient teacher knew of other inhabited worlds near us.
